messages:
Ava CSM: @Lauren thanks for filling the intake form — can you confirm the primary extraction goals and any hard constraints?
Lauren (Zenith): We're building a claims NER to pull claimant name, policy_number, diagnosis codes (ICD-10). Data includes PII and PHI. We need private deployment (VPC/on-prem option) and SOC2 compliance. Pilot target: 6 weeks.
Ava CSM: Got it. We'll need a sample dataset + risk assessment. @Raj can you estimate infra and a basic eval plan?
Raj SE: Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Private VPC vs fully on-prem? 2) Do you need HSM-integrated key management? For PHI, Private or Dedicated with strict networking is safest. My baseline recommendation: start with a 13B quantized model, add OCR preprocessing for scanned docs.
Lauren (Zenith): Private VPC preferred. We'll want redaction for policy numbers before storage. We can provide an initial 200 de-identified records; some will be PDFs.
Samir Security: Please confirm data classification (PHI/PII) and whether Zenith will pre-mask with DLP. We'll need a data flow diagram, retention policy, and proof of keys (KMS/HSM). For PHI, enable stricter log ephemerality.
Maya CSE: I'll own the onboarding checklist and tracking. Lauren — can you upload the sample + expected labels (NER spans) to the secure intake link? https://redwood.example.com/secure-upload/zenith
Lauren (Zenith): Uploading now. Note: OCR quality varies; some scanned forms are low-res. We'll include sample PDFs.
Raj SE: Eval plan sketch: run NER metrics (token-level F1, precision, recall), entity-level exact match, and a redaction FP rate. Initial eval set recommendation: 2k labeled records derived from sanitized production. Canary rollout idea: 10 req/s, 5% traffic, auto-fallback to hosted 13B if errors or latency SLO breaches >1%.
Ava CSM: Heads up — Zenith is budget-constrained and this pilot determines renewal cadence. We should formalize SOW + success criteria (min F1, latency targets, privacy controls) before the pilot start.
Samir Security: Also confirm logs retention: default is 30 days, but for PHI we require 7-day ephemeral logs unless customer signs extended retention and additional controls.
Maya CSE: Action items: (1) Raj to draft infra + eval plan by EOD (timestamp ref 1842550000), (2) Samir to send security checklist & required docs, (3) Lauren to confirm sample upload + OCR notes, (4) Ava to schedule kickoff demo next Tue.
Ava CSM: Thanks everyone — @onboard-bot please create a ticket and link the intake assets.
onboard-bot: Created ticket RED-18425 for Zenith Private onboarding. Assigned: Maya CSE, Raj SE, Samir Security.
Lauren (Zenith): Thanks! Appreciate the quick turnaround. :heart:
